name: Simulation-Based Inference (SBI)
summary: Infer simulator parameters when generating synthetic data is feasible but evaluating the likelihood is difficult.
summary_zh: 利用可调用的随机或复杂仿真器生成数据，在似然不可直接计算时进行参数推断。
core_idea: Use simulated parameter-observation pairs to approximate posteriors, likelihoods or likelihood ratios.
innovation: Connects classical inverse statistics with neural conditional density estimation and likelihood-free workflows.
limitations: Posterior validity depends on simulator faithfulness and calibration.

start_here.why: High-level authoritative overview connecting scientific simulators and likelihood-free inference.
start_here.focus: Three approaches: posterior, likelihood and likelihood-ratio estimation.
